criteria.requirement: Fix noninjectable applied to classes by validating/storing exclusions on the final __init__, preserving original class identity and both inject/noninjectable decorator orders. Handle kw-only/frozen dataclasses and merged multiple exclusions. When restricting an inherited constructor, create a subclass-local metadata wrapper instead of mutating the shared base method. Preserve function/method behavior, get_bindings exclusion, explicit additional_kwargs priority and UnknownArgument for nonexistent parameters; missing manual values must fail rather than auto-inject int zero.
